binary_coherence_tax.why: Token-logit: native greedy already disagrees at generated token 0 (271 vs 15769). Layer/organ/channel: teacher-forced GEMVs on real hold-set post_attn_norm activations (down_proj on teacher SwiGLU hidden), binary g64 vs q2f g64 vs teacher.
